map.划格法结合力得分：0级→100、1级→85、2级→65、3级→40、4级→20、: Cross-cut adhesion score: grade 0→100, 1→85, 2→65, 3→40, 4→20, 5→0; pull-off: ≥15 MPa→100, 10~15→85, 5~10→65, 3~5→40; thickness deviation = (measured thickness − standard thickness)/standard thickness ×100%
map.结合力得分 ≥ 要求等级对应分值时结合力判合格；涂层硬度按铅笔硬度或维氏/纳米压: Adhesion passes when the score meets or exceeds the value required for the grade; coating hardness is measured by pencil hardness or Vickers / nanoindentation; thickness deviation must fall within the allowed tolerance. Together the three assess coating quality.

map.划格法和拉开法怎么选？: How to choose between the cross-cut method and the pull-off method?
map.划格法适合较薄涂层、操作快捷；拉开法给出定量附着力（MPa），适合要求定量验收的: The cross-cut method suits thin coatings and is quick; the pull-off method gives quantitative adhesion (MPa) and suits cases requiring quantitative acceptance.
map.涂层越厚越耐蚀吗？: The thicker the coating, the more corrosion resistant?
map.不一定。过厚易开裂、附着力下降，应在标准范围内控制厚度。: Not necessarily. Too thick cracks easily and reduces adhesion; keep the thickness within the standard range.
